title: Superintelligent Software Engineering: Governance That Scales with Capability
title_zh: 超级智能软件工程：与能力同步扩展的治理

paragraphs.en: Software agents are being trained to exceed human engineers; we argue that capability alone does not produce better software engineering. We define superintelligent software engineering as the discipline of building and evolving software with agents whose capability exceeds that of human engineers, in which governance (gates, contracts, decisions and decay control) scales with capability. The argument rests on three claims. First, correctness in a project rests on decisions and contracts that the code does not carry. Second, knowledge decays. Third, once an agent outpaces its reviewers, reading catches a shrinking share of the changes built on stale knowledge. A simple model shows that, past a fixed review capacity, escaping changes grow linearly with throughput while the share that reading catches falls toward zero; governance can lower the slope, capability alone cannot. An exploratory snapshot of 452 of the most-starred public GitHub repositories finds a root-level or .github agent context file in 48.67% (95% confidence interval 44.1 to 53.3); in the median file that names repository paths, 9.5% to 22% of those paths do not resolve, depending on how a reference is read. We then present OSTEON, a discipline for the regime, released with a DOI ( 10.5281/zenodo.23436020 ): each project gets a governed knowledge repository of decisions and contracts, every change is checked mechanically against it, and the knowledge itself is checked for decay at every session start; planning is gated, and sessions record what they learn without writing rules. We report no measured effect of OSTEON, mark claims about its mechanisms as opinion and the author’s practice heuristics as design rationale, and state the questions that would falsify the thesis.
paragraphs.zh: 软件智能体正被训练得超越人类工程师；我们认为，仅有能力并不足以产出更好的软件工程。 我们将超智能软件工程定义为：以能力超越人类工程师的智能体来构建和演进软件的学科，其中治理（门禁、契约、决策与衰减控制）随能力同步扩展。 这一论证基于三点主张。 第一，项目的正确性依赖于代码本身并不承载的决策与契约。 第二，知识会衰减。 第三，一旦智能体的速度超过其审查者，阅读所能覆盖的、建立在过时知识之上的变更份额将不断缩小。 一个简单的模型表明，在审查容量固定的情况下，超过该容量后，漏审的变更随吞吐量线性增长，而阅读所能覆盖的份额趋近于零；治理可以降低这一斜率，而单靠能力不能。 对 452 个获星数最多的公开 GitHub 仓库的探索性快照发现，48.67% 的仓库（95% 置信区间为 44.1 至 53.3）存在根目录级或 .github 目录下的智能体上下文文件；在那些指明仓库路径的文件的中位数情形中，取决于引用的解读方式，9.5% 至 22% 的路径无法解析。 随后我们提出 OSTEON，一种面向该体制的规程，并以 DOI（ 10.5281/zenodo.23436020 ）发布：每个项目都拥有一个受治理的、存放决策与契约的知识仓库，每项变更都以机械化方式对照该仓库进行校验，且知识本身在每次会话开始时都会接受衰减检查；规划受门禁约束，会话记录其所学而不写入规则。 我们报告 OSTEON 尚无实测效果，将关于其机制的论断标注为观点，将作者的实践启发法标注为设计依据，并陈述能够证伪本论题的问题。

paragraphs.en: Coding agents now resolve real issues in real repositories, and benchmarks such as SWE-bench [ 1 ] track how often they succeed. One route to better software engineering is to train more capable agents; we call it the training route , and it now states its goal plainly. Self-play SWE-RL trains a single agent to inject and repair bugs of rising difficulty in real codebases, with no human-labelled issues or tests, and presents itself as a first step toward training superintelligent software agents [ 2 ] . If that route succeeds, the agents that work in a codebase will, on much of the work, exceed the engineers who are responsible for it. Fig. 1 summarises the argument of this paper.
paragraphs.zh: 编码智能体现在能够在真实代码库中解决真实问题，而像 SWE-bench [ 1 ] 这样的基准测试则追踪它们成功的频率。 提升软件工程能力的一条路径是训练更强大的智能体；我们称之为训练路径，如今它已直白地表明了其目标。 自博弈 SWE-RL 训练单个智能体在真实代码库中注入并修复难度递增的缺陷，无需人工标注的问题或测试，并将其自身呈现为迈向训练超级智能软件智能体的第一步 [ 2 ] 。 如果这条路径取得成功，那么在代码库中工作的智能体将在大部分工作上超越负责该代码库的工程师。 图 1 概括了本文的论证。

paragraphs.en: This paper asks what engineering discipline that regime requires. Our answer is that capability is necessary and not sufficient. Software engineering has never been only the production of code that passes its tests. It is the production of code that is correct with respect to what a project has decided: the trade-offs it accepted, the contracts it holds with its neighbours, and the state of the system it actually runs. Most of that knowledge lives outside the code. It changes, and parts of it go stale without anyone noticing. In a snapshot of 452 of the most-starred public GitHub repositories, 48.67% carry a root-level or .github file written to brief coding agents. In the median such file that names repository paths, between 9.5% and 22% of those paths do not resolve, depending on how a path reference is read (Section IV ). An unresolved path is a mismatch between a file and its tree, not shown to be a wrong instruction; it is one observable form of the drift this paper is about. An agent that consults stale knowledge may build the wrong change, and cannot tell that it has. We expect a more capable agent to build it faster, at larger scope, and to defend it better. [Opinion]

paragraphs.en: Our thesis is therefore a scaling claim: governance has to scale with capability. Four things must grow in reach and fall in cost as agents grow in capability: the gates a change passes, the contracts it is checked against, the decisions it must respect, and the control of how that knowledge decays. If they do not, we argue, more capability produces more confident error.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们的论点是一个规模化的主张：治理必须随能力一同扩展。 随着智能体能力不断增强，有四样东西必须在覆盖范围上增长、在成本上下降：变更所须通过的关口、变更所须遵守的契约、变更所须尊重的决策，以及对这些知识如何衰减的控制。 我们认为，如果这四者不随之扩展，更强的能力只会产生更自信的错误。

paragraphs.en: This is a vision paper with a solution and one exploratory measurement. It reports no measurement of OSTEON and claims no measured effect. Section IV examines one premise of the argument, that written project knowledge drifts from the system it describes, in public agent context files. It is a single observational snapshot: it describes, and it tests no cause. Sections VI and VII describe mechanisms, and each can be checked against the released artifact [ 3 ] . Where a sentence claims what a mechanism achieves in practice rather than what it does, it is an opinion, and it is marked [Opinion] where it stands. The scenarios in Section VII are constructed to show a mechanism; they are not drawn from data. Section VIII states design heuristics from the author’s own practice; each is marked [Experience] and is likewise not evidence. Section VI-H gives a descriptive reading of OSTEON’s own version history, offered as a check on the mechanisms, not as a measurement of their effect.

paragraphs.zh: 定义。 超级智能软件工程是一门构建和演进由智能体完成的软件的学科，这些智能体的能力超越人类工程师，且治理（门禁、契约、决策与衰减控制）随能力同步扩展。

sents.en: Definition.
sents.zh: 定义。

paragraphs.en: The definition is the one the OSTEON release carries [ 3 ] ; this paper argues it. Each of its three parts does work.
paragraphs.zh: 该定义是 OSTEON 版本所采用的定义 [ 3 ]；本文对其加以论证。 它的三个部分各自都发挥作用。

paragraphs.en: Building and evolving. The definition covers the whole life of a system, not its first release. Lehman observed that a program used in the real world must keep changing or become progressively less useful [ 4 ] , and Parnas described how software ages as the world around it moves [ 5 ] . The regime we address is mostly evolution: agents changing systems whose decisions were taken earlier, by other people, for reasons that may no longer hold.
paragraphs.zh: 构建与演进。 这一定义涵盖了系统的整个生命周期，而不仅仅是它的首次发布。 Lehman 观察到，在现实世界中被使用的程序必须持续变化，否则会逐渐变得不再有用[4]，而 Parnas 描述了随着周围世界的变化软件是如何老化的[5]。 我们所讨论的机制主要是演进：智能体在修改那些由其他人早先做出决策、而这些决策所依据的理由可能已不再成立的系统。

paragraphs.en: Agents whose capability exceeds that of human engineers. We do not require superintelligence in the general sense of an intellect that exceeds human performance in virtually all domains of interest [ 6 ] . We require something narrower and nearer: that on the work delegated to it, an agent produces output that the project’s engineers could not produce, or could not verify line by line, in the time available. Capability is measured against the humans who govern the project. The regime therefore arrives unevenly, task by task and project by project, long before any general superintelligence.
paragraphs.zh: 能力超过人类工程师的智能体。 我们并不要求一般意义上的超级智能，即在几乎所有感兴趣的领域中都能超过人类表现的智能 [ 6 ] 。 我们要求的是更窄、更贴近的东西：对于委派给它的那部分工作，智能体所产出的成果是项目工程师在可用时间内无法产出的，或无法逐行验证的。 能力是以治理该项目的人类为基准来衡量的。 因此，这一治理体制将不均衡地到来，逐个任务、逐个项目地出现，远早于任何一般性的超级智能。

paragraphs.en: The condition is relative, and it includes speed. The regime is defined by the gap between an agent’s output and the project’s capacity to verify it, not by intelligence in the general sense: an agent can enter it by depth, by scope or by speed. An agent no better than its reviewers but much faster also produces more than they can verify in time, and the model of Section III-C treats the two cases alike, because capability enters it only through throughput r r and scope k k . We keep the term because the training route names superintelligent agents as its target [ 2 ] , because depth is the case in which verification fails even when there is time, and because we address the regime in which both the quality and the volume of agent output exceed what reviewers can check; the fast but ordinary agent is a transitional case that the same governance covers.
paragraphs.zh: 该条件是相对的，并且包含速度。 该机制的定义在于智能体的产出与项目验证能力之间的差距，而非一般意义上的智能：智能体可以通过深度、通过广度或通过速度进入该机制。 一个并不比其审阅者更强但速度快得多的智能体，同样会产出超过审阅者能够及时验证的量，而第 III-C 节的模型将这两种情况同等对待，因为能力在其中仅通过吞吐量 r r 和广度 k k 起作用。 我们保留这一术语，是因为该训练路线将超级智能的智能体列为目标 [ 2 ]，是因为深度正是即使有充足时间验证仍会失败的情形，也是因为我们所讨论的正是智能体产出的质量与数量都超出审阅者所能核查范围的机制；快而平庸的智能体是一种过渡情形，同样由该治理方式覆盖。

paragraphs.en: Governance scales with capability. This is the defining property. A practice in which agents become more capable while the governance around them stays fixed is not superintelligent software engineering. It is ordinary software engineering run faster, and Section III argues that it fails in a predictable way. A practice meets the definition when it meets the requirements of Section V ; whether its governance then scales in fact is the empirical question of Section XI .
paragraphs.zh: 治理随能力扩展。 这是决定性的属性。 一种智能体能力不断提升而其周围治理却保持固定的实践，并不是超级智能软件工程。 它只是运转更快的普通软件工程，第三节将论证它将以一种可预测的方式失败。 当一种实践满足第五节的要求时，它就符合该定义；其治理随后是否真正扩展，则是第十一节要回答的经验问题。

paragraphs.en: The definition is stipulative: it names the discipline by the property we argue for, and does not by itself show that the property is needed; a reader who rejects Section III can accept the definition and hold the discipline empty. We keep apart the regime, a descriptive condition on verification capacity (Section II-A ); the discipline, a normative practice for it; and the claim that the practice is needed, which Section III argues and Section XI says how to refute.
paragraphs.zh: 该定义是规定性的：它以我们所论证的性质来命名该学科，但本身并不能证明该性质是必要的；不认可第三节的读者可以接受该定义，同时认为该学科是空洞的。 我们将三者区分开来：机制（regime），即关于验证能力的描述性条件（第II-A节）；规范（discipline），即针对该机制的规范性实践；以及该实践是必要的这一主张，第三节论证了这一主张，第十一节说明了如何反驳它。

paragraphs.en: It helps to separate three regimes by who can verify a change (Fig. 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 区分三种情形很有帮助，依据是谁能够验证一项变更（图 2 ）。

paragraphs.en: Assisted. A human writes or closely reads every change, and the reviewer understands the change at least as well as its author (in the terms of Section III-C : every change is reviewed and detection is high).
paragraphs.zh: 辅助型。 每一次变更都由人类编写或仔细阅读，且审查者对变更的理解程度至少不低于其作者（用第 III-C 节的术语来说：每次变更都经过审查且检测率很高）。

paragraphs.en: Delegated. An agent writes and a human reads every change, which is possible only because throughput is held at or below review capacity: review is the binding constraint ( ρ = 1 \rho=1 because r r is capped at c c ). Most current practice sits here. As we read them, the settings that SE 3.0 [ 7 ] and agentic software engineering [ 8 ] describe sit here too, because in both a human still reads and approves each change or its evidence pack.
paragraphs.zh: 委派型。 智能体编写变更，而人类阅读每一个变更，这之所以可行，是因为吞吐量被保持在评审能力或以下：评审是约束性瓶颈（ρ=1，因为 r 被限制在 c 以内）。 目前的大多数实践都处于这一档。 按我们的理解，SE 3.0 [7] 与智能体化软件工程 [8] 所描述的情境也属于这一档，因为在两者之中，人类仍然要阅读并批准每个变更或其证据包。

paragraphs.en: Superintelligent software engineering is the discipline for the superseded regime and for the transition into it. The transition is gradual and mixed: within one project, a schema migration may be superseded while a pricing rule is still assisted. A project can stay delegated by capping its agents at review capacity. That forgoes the capability. The superseded regime is entered by projects that do not cap it, and our claim is conditional on entering it.
paragraphs.zh: 超级智能软件工程是一门针对被取代 regime 以及向其过渡过程的学科。 这一过渡是渐进且混合的：在同一个项目中，一次 schema 迁移可能已被取代，而一条定价规则仍处于辅助状态。 一个项目可以通过将其智能体的能力限制在审查容量之内来保持委托状态。 但这样就放弃了该能力。 被取代 regime 是由不做此类限制的项目进入的，而我们的论断以进入该 regime 为前提条件。

paragraphs.en: Recent work has named the agent (Self-play SWE-RL [ 2 ] ), the era (SE 3.0, an AI-native era with its technology stack [ 7 ] ), the human-agent duality (agentic software engineering, with workbenches for SE for Humans and for SE for Agents [ 8 ] ) and the trust problem (Roychoudhury et al., who argue that agent-written code needs trust at least equal to that placed in human practice and look to analysis tools paired with the agent to supply it [ 9 ] ), but not the discipline. We use discipline in the sense of a defined body of practice, not of an established research community. None of these works makes the scaling of governance the defining property of a practice for the regime in which agents outstrip their reviewers. We are not aware of an earlier definition of superintelligent software engineering as a discipline; a search for the phrase on 2026-10-17 found it only as the target of agent training [ 2 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 近期的工作已经命名了智能体（Self-play SWE-RL [ 2 ]）、时代（SE 3.0，一个拥有其技术栈的AI原生时代 [ 7 ]）、人-智能体二元性（智能体化软件工程，设有面向人类的软件工程工作台和面向智能体的软件工程工作台 [ 8 ]）以及信任问题（Roychoudhury等人认为，智能体编写的代码所需要的信任至少应等同于人类实践中所获得的信任，并寄望于与智能体配套的分析工具来提供这种信任 [ 9 ]），但尚未命名这门学科。 我们所说的学科，是指一套有明确界定的实践体系，而非一个已确立的研究共同体。 在智能体超越其审查者的体制下，这些工作都没有把治理的可扩展性作为一门实践的决定性特征。 我们尚未见有人更早地将超智能软件工程定义为一门学科；2026年10月17日对该短语的检索显示，它仅作为智能体训练的目标出现 [ 2 ]。

paragraphs.en: The training route improves what an agent can do with the knowledge it has. Three claims explain why that is not the same as engineering a project well: correctness, decay and throughput (Sections III-A to III-C ). Two further points say what follows for oversight and for authority (Sections III-D and III-E ).

paragraphs.en: A change is correct relative to an intent. Some intent is written in tests, and the training route uses exactly that: in self-play SWE-RL each bug is specified by a test patch [ 2 ] . Much of a project’s intent, however, is neither in its tests nor recoverable from its code: why a retry is capped where it is; which team owns a field, and in what unit; which approach was tried and rejected; which part of the system is in production and which is a prototype. These are decisions and contracts. Architecture research has long treated decisions as first-class knowledge that the code does not preserve [ 10 , 11 ] . The lightweight decision record, a short written record of one decision and its reasons, exists because that rationale is otherwise lost [ 12 ] . A more capable agent infers more from code. It cannot infer a decision that left no trace, and it cannot know that a decision it does infer has since been reversed.
paragraphs.zh: 一次改动是否正确，是相对于某个意图而言的。 有些意图写在测试里，而训练路线恰恰使用了这一点：在自博弈 SWE-RL 中，每个 bug 都由一个测试补丁来指定 [ 2 ] 。 然而，项目的大部分意图既不在其测试中，也无法从其代码中还原：为什么重试次数恰好限制在那个数值；哪个团队负责某个字段，以及它以什么为单位；哪种方案曾被尝试又被否决；系统的哪个部分在生产运行，哪个部分是原型。 这些是决策与契约。 架构研究长期以来一直把决策视为代码所无法保存的一等知识 [ 10 , 11 ] 。 轻量级决策记录，即对某一个决策及其理由的简短书面记录，其存在正是因为这些理据否则就会丢失 [ 12 ] 。 更强的智能体能从代码中推断出更多东西。 它无法推断出一个没有留下任何痕迹的决策，也无法知道它推断出的某个决策后来已被推翻。

paragraphs.en: The knowledge that does get written down drifts from the system it describes. Documentation that was true when written goes stale as the code, the deployment and the organisation move; code and its comments co-evolve only loosely [ 13 ] , code-comment inconsistencies are common in mature projects [ 14 ] , and outdated content is among the most reported documentation problems [ 15 ] . A stale fact can be worse than a missing one: an agent treats it as current and acts on it with full confidence. Section IV measures one possible symptom of this drift in public repositories.
paragraphs.zh: 真正被写下来的知识会逐渐偏离它所描述的系统。 编写时正确的文档会随着代码、部署和组织的变动而变得过时；代码与其注释只是松散地共同演化 [ 13 ]，在成熟项目中代码与注释不一致的情况很常见 [ 14 ]，而过时的内容是报告最多的文档问题之一 [ 15 ]。 一个过时的事实可能比缺失的事实更糟：智能体会将其视为当前信息，并满怀信心地据此行动。 第 IV 节在公开仓库中测量了这种漂移的一个可能症状。

paragraphs.en: A recent controlled evaluation of repository context files bears on this. Gloaguen et al. found that providing context files such as AGENTS.md does not generally improve task success, while it raises inference cost by over a fifth on average. Instructions in the files are followed, but repository overviews do not help [ 16 ] . Gloaguen et al. themselves conclude that such files are useful for specifying non-standard coding practices. Our own addition, not theirs, is that the lever is not more context but current context: what an agent cannot derive from the code is a small set of non-standard, project-specific facts, and their value depends on whether they are current. Context that is ungoverned, unversioned and unchecked for decay is cost with no assurance of benefit.
paragraphs.zh: 最近一项针对仓库上下文文件的受控评估与此相关。 Gloaguen 等人发现，提供诸如 AGENTS.md 之类的上下文文件通常并不能提高任务成功率，反而使推理成本平均上升了五分之一以上。 文件中的指令会被遵循，但仓库概览并无帮助 [ 16 ] 。 Gloaguen 等人自己也得出结论，认为这类文件可用于规定非标准的编码惯例。 我们自己的补充观点（而非他们的观点）是：关键杠杆不在于更多上下文，而在于最新的上下文——智能体无法从代码中推导出的，是一小部分非标准的、项目特定的事实，而这些事实的价值取决于它们是否是最新的。 未经治理、未纳入版本控制且未检查是否过时的上下文，是只有成本却没有收益保证的东西。

paragraphs.en: Of the terms in Eq. ( 2 ), capability acts on r r and k k . Governance acts on two factors without adding reviewers: the staleness factor, through s s , and the review factor, through ρ \rho and d d . Decay control lowers s s by finding stale units before they are consulted. Gates act on the review factor. By mechanical we mean run on every change at no human cost. A gate runs on every change, so it sets ρ \rho to 1, and it holds a change that rests on a unit already flagged as stale with its own probability g g in place of a reader’s d d (Fig. 3 ). Its other job, catching a change that contradicts a current record, is a second error channel that Eq. ( 2 ) does not count (the second scenario of Section VII shows it). The two factors are not independent: a gate cannot detect a record that is itself stale and unflagged, and a stale-built change that agrees with such a record passes it. The gate’s g g is therefore bounded by the currency of the record it checks against, which is why decay control comes first, and why the gate curve in Fig. 3 assumes a current record. In OSTEON 0.1.0 the decay check and the lints are scripts; the review gate is a procedure the agent executes against the record, so its g g is a property of the agent and the record together, which is why Q5 of Section XI asks whether it holds as capability rises.

paragraphs.en: When the supervised system exceeds its supervisor, oversight has to be designed so that the supervisor can still judge something that matters. This is the problem of scalable oversight [ 18 , 19 ] . In the superseded regime the reviewer cannot judge every change. The reviewer can still judge the decisions and contracts the change is checked against, because those are short, stable, human-approved and far fewer than the changes. Superintelligent software engineering moves human verification from the change to the knowledge, and mechanises the step from knowledge to change.
paragraphs.zh: 当被监督系统超过其监督者时，监督的设计必须让监督者仍然能够判断某些重要的东西。 这就是可扩展监督问题 [ 18 , 19 ] 。 在被取代的情境下，审查者无法判断每一次变更。 审查者仍然可以判断变更所依据的决策与契约，因为这些内容简短、稳定、经过人类批准，且数量远少于变更本身。 超级智能软件工程将人类验证从变更转移到知识上，并使从知识到变更的步骤机械化。

paragraphs.en: A decision records a trade-off among things a project’s owners answer for: cost, risk, obligations to users and to other teams. An agent may predict the consequences of a decision better than any engineer and still not be the party entitled to take it. We hold that the boundary of human authority should not move as capability grows; what should fall is the cost of exercising it. [Opinion]
paragraphs.zh: 决策记录的是项目所有者所负责的各项事务之间的权衡：成本、风险、对用户和其他团队的义务。 一个智能体可能比任何工程师都能更好地预测决策的后果，但它仍然不是有权做出该决策的一方。 我们认为，人类权威的边界不应随着能力的增长而移动；应该下降的是行使权威的成本。[Opinion]

paragraphs.en: sorted by stars in descending order, and took the first five pages of 100 results. The query matched 5 346 repositories, and the five pages returned 500, none marked incomplete and none duplicated across pages (Table I ). We excluded 47 repositories with no primary language, a rule meant to remove lists and books. One repository matched a list, fixed before collection, of names the author does not report on for reasons of confidentiality; it was excluded, and it is counted but not named. All 452 eligible repositories were measured, no repository tree was unavailable, and every context file’s content and path history were available. For 7 repositories the recursive tree listing was truncated, so the context-file paths were checked one by one through the contents API. The snapshot date, 2026-10-18 (UTC), is the reference for every age; collection used read-only endpoints only. The eligible repositories hold between 50 069 and 554 124 stars and are assigned 32 primary languages; Python (130), TypeScript (85), JavaScript (50), Rust (33) and Go (32) account for 330 of the 452. The frame is released with the dataset ( frame.csv ).

paragraphs.en: Pre-specification. The frame, the file list and the metrics were written down verbatim, in the study’s protocol and in the header of the collection script, before collection began. One robustness change was made after a small test on a separate cache and before the full run: the tree call was set to tolerate two further HTTP error responses (403 and 451); the test data were not used, the protocol records the change in a dated note, and no tree call in the full run failed, so the change affected no result. The summary statistics (medians and quartiles, the pooled rate, the share of files with any unresolved reference) and the single association reported, commits since update against the dangling-reference rate, were implemented in summarize.py before collection and were not changed afterwards; every other comparison in this section is labelled post hoc, including the audit in Section IV-D and the intervals and breakdowns added at revision. The pre-specification is recorded only in the released files; it was not registered with a third party, so it rests on the author’s word, the file record and the dated deviation note.
paragraphs.zh: 预先规定。 框架、文件清单和指标在收集开始之前已逐字写下，载于研究方案和收集脚本的文件头中。 在对单独的缓存进行小规模测试之后、完整运行之前，做了一处稳健性修改：将树调用设置为可容忍另外两种 HTTP 错误响应（403 和 451）；测试数据未被使用，方案中以带日期的记录记下了这一修改，且完整运行中没有一次树调用失败，因此该修改未影响任何结果。 汇总统计量（中位数和四分位数、合并比率、存在任何未解析引用的文件占比）以及唯一报告的关联——更新以来的提交数与悬空引用率——均在收集之前实现于 summarize.py 中，此后未作更改；本节中所有其他比较均标注为事后分析，包括 IV-D 节的审计以及在修订时新增的区间和细分。 预先规定仅记录在公开发布的文件中；未向第三方登记，因此它依赖于作者本人的一句话、文件记录以及带日期的偏差说明。

paragraphs.en: MQ1: Prevalence. Of the 452 eligible repositories, 220 (48.67%; 95% confidence interval 44.1 to 53.3; 44.0% over all 500 returned repositories) carry at least one root-level or .github context file. Prevalence varies by language: TypeScript 62 of 85 and Go 23 of 32, against Python 53 of 130, JavaScript 19 of 50 and Java 4 of 15 (post hoc breakdown). Together the sample repositories hold 367 files, a median of 2 per repository (25th percentile 1, 75th percentile 2, maximum 4). The most frequent names are AGENTS.md (189 files) and CLAUDE.md (112 files); Table I gives the full breakdown. Of the 367 files, 35 are stored as symbolic links. Nested AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md files are common as well: 102 repositories hold 1 299 of them, 88 of these repositories (1 277 files) in the sample and 14 outside it.

paragraphs.en: MQ2: Currency. Table II and Fig. 4 summarise the per-file measures. Context files have a median age of 220 days (25th to 75th percentile 144 to 324.5) and a median of 48 days since their last update (10 to 167). They have a median of 5 updates (1 to 18). Since their last update, their repositories have received a median of 229 further commits (49 to 852). The distribution has a heavy upper tail, reaching 91 084 commits, because the count includes every commit dated after the update, merged branches included (bootstrap 95% interval for the median, 168 to 307). The 35 symbolic links are rows whose text is a target name, so they need no update when their target changes; over the 332 other files the medians are 40 days since update (25th to 75th percentile 9 to 134) and 197.5 commits since update (45 to 663.5), and the age median is 219.5, against 220 over all files. By file name (post hoc), AGENTS.md files are the most current (median 17 days since update, 125 commits since) and CLAUDE.md files the least (124.5 days, 457 commits); median dangling rates are 0.22 and 0.27, and 0.15 for copilot-instructions.md . paragraphs.en: MQ3: Resolution. Of the 367 files, 269 contain at least one path-like candidate (Fig. 5 ); none of the 35 symbolic links has one, because a link’s text is its target. paragraphs.en: After seeing the primary results, we audited the 2 003 unresolved references and, after inspecting the most frequent unresolved tokens, defined two classes that are unlikely to be meant as tracked repository paths: bare extensions such as .ts (97), and paths under build or local folders such as dist or node_modules , which repositories usually do not commit (95). paragraphs.en: The snapshot shows that the mismatch the premise of Section III predicts is common; it does not show how it arose. About half of the popular repositories we measured brief their agents through context files. For half of those files, the repository has received 229 or more commits since the file last changed. Under all three readings, most files that name repository paths name at least one that does not resolve. The one association we examined does not support a simple accumulation story: files that stood still through more commits do not have more unresolved references, at file or at repository level.

paragraphs.en: The measurement does not show that unresolved references mislead agents, that they cause defects, or that any governance practice, OSTEON included, would reduce them. Nor is it a judgement of any project: a reference that does not resolve may name a file the build generates, a path in another repository, or a file that is planned, and whether a given referent moved, was never created, or is generated is not determined. Its role is narrower: written path references that do not resolve against the current tree are common in public repositories today, and they are one observable form of the mismatch that R5 (decay is checked at the start) targets. It supplies a cross-sectional reference point for Q3 of the research agenda (Section XI ): a level at one date, not a decay rate.
paragraphs.zh: 该测量并未表明未解析的引用会误导智能体、会导致缺陷，或表明任何治理实践（包括 OSTEON）会减少它们。 它也不是对任何项目的评判：一个无法解析的引用可能指向构建生成的文件、另一个仓库中的路径，或一个计划创建的文件，而某个给定引用对象是被移动了、从未被创建，还是由生成的，这一点并未确定。 它的作用更窄：在今天的公开仓库中，针对当前目录树无法解析的书面路径引用很常见，它们是 R5（衰减在开始时被检查）所针对的那种失配的一种可观察形式。 它为研究议程的 Q3（第 XI 节）提供一个横截面参考点：某一日期的水平，而非衰减率。

paragraphs.en: Construct validity. An unresolved reference is a symptom, not a defect. Candidates are found by pattern, not by understanding. Some flagged strings are not meant as paths, such as a package name that ends in a file extension, a path the build creates, a Git reference such as origin/main , a branch-name prefix such as feat/ read as a directory, or the literal N/A ; the released candidate list shows each one, and the post hoc readings remove none of these when the token contains a slash. Some real references are missed, such as paths in prose without code formatting, paths inside fenced blocks, and bare names without an extension. The post hoc readings bound part of this effect, not all of it. The rate rises with the number of candidates a file holds ( r S = 0.41 r_{\text{S}}=0.41 over the 269 files; candidates per file have a median of 13, 25th to 75th percentile 4 to 31; of the 35 files with a single candidate, 3 have it unresolved). This is consistent with more drift in path-heavy files and with a heuristic whose false-positive share grows with file length, and the snapshot cannot separate the two. Commits since update counts every commit dated after the update, merged branches included, so it can overstate activity; we report medians for this reason. For 2 files the context-file commit was not found on the last page of the activity range, so their count is not reduced by one.

paragraphs.en: Internal validity. They have no candidates and so no dangling-reference rate. The unit of analysis is the file, and files are not independent across a repository; the repository-level figures in Section IV-C are the check. paragraphs.en: OSTEON is a proposed discipline for superintelligent software engineering. Release 0.1.0 is a plugin for the Claude Code agent. It contains fifteen skills (procedures the agent follows; the source repositories hold further skills that the release does not ship), a scaffold for the project knowledge repository, and a session-start decay check. Content is under CC BY 4.0 and scripts under MIT [ 3 ] . Fig. 6 shows the parts described in this section and how they connect.

paragraphs.en: OSTEON places every fact at one of three tiers (R1). The organisation tier (T0) holds the methodology: how to record a decision, version a contract, run curation. The project tier (T1) holds the project’s facts, decisions, contracts and procedures. The repository tier (T2) holds conventions that are true inside one code repository only, in that repository’s own agent instruction file. A fact lives at the narrowest tier that fully owns it. When it could sit at two, it is placed by what would change it, not by its topic. For example, the port a service listens on belongs to the repository whose configuration sets it (T2), while the decision to run that service at all belongs to the project (T1), because different events change each. Personal preferences and an individual’s memory sit outside all tiers, and the project’s knowledge never governs or cites them.
paragraphs.zh: OSTEON 将每条事实置于三个层级之一（R1）。 组织层级（T0）存放方法论：如何记录决策、如何为合同建立版本、如何进行策展。 项目层级（T1）存放项目的事实、决策、合同与流程。 仓库层级（T2）存放仅在某一个代码仓库内部成立的约定，写在该仓库自己的智能体指令文件中。 一条事实存放在能够完全拥有它的最窄层级上。 当它可能属于两个层级时，以其会被什么改变来决定放置位置，而不是按其主题。 例如，某服务监听的端口属于设定该配置的仓库（T2），而是否运行该服务这一决策则属于项目（T1），因为改变两者的因素不同。 个人偏好与个人记忆位于所有层级之外，项目的知识从不支配或引用它们。

paragraphs.en: The project tier is a dedicated repository, the project’s bone . It holds no product code. It holds four layers. L1 is a constitution: the project’s non-negotiables, the rules the other layers may not override, and what may not be decided unilaterally. L2 holds decisions and dated records of the running system’s state as last verified. L3 holds contracts and domain knowledge. L4 holds the project’s own skills: the procedures an agent follows inside the project. A manifest declares which files are knowledge units and which sources are watched. Because the bone is a repository, its knowledge has what code already has: history, branches, review and provenance. The names follow one metaphor: the project’s knowledge repository is its bone , knowledge that has been verified and gated is ossified , and work proceeds by planned ossification (Section VI-F ).

paragraphs.en: Decision records follow the architecture decision record tradition [ 12 ] , with a numbered identity and a lifecycle of proposed, accepted and superseded (R2). An accepted record is amended or superseded, never rewritten, so the reason a project once had survives the decision that replaced it. The decision skill also handles the case that matters most for agents, a merged change that silently suspends a decision or an accepted record that no longer matches what the running system does: the mismatch is made explicit as an amendment or a supersession, rather than left as a contradiction between the record and the code.
paragraphs.zh: 决策记录遵循架构决策记录传统 [ 12 ]，具有编号标识以及提议、接受和被取代的生命周期（R2）。 已接受的记录会被修订或取代，而从不被重写，因此项目曾经的理由会延续存在，即使替代它的决策已经出现。 决策技能还处理对智能体最重要的情形：一个被合并的更改悄然搁置了某条决策，或某条已接受的记录不再与运行中的系统的实际行为相符；此时这种不一致会以修订或取代的形式被显式化，而不是任其作为记录与代码之间的矛盾留存下去。

paragraphs.en: Every seam between two modules has a contract (R3): the wire format, fields, units, authentication and failure behaviour that both sides implement against. Contracts follow semantic versioning [ 23 ] in the spirit of design by contract [ 24 ] , and are indexed in a registry. One rule carries most of the weight: a contract change ships in the same wave , that is, in the same change request, as the interface change it describes, never after it. The skill also triggers when one side of a seam is being built against the other side’s source code instead of its written contract, which is the usual way an agent learns an interface it should have read.
paragraphs.zh: 每两个模块之间的接缝都有一份契约（R3）：即双方共同遵循实现的线格式、字段、单位、认证方式与失败行为。 契约遵循契约式设计的思想 [ 23 ]，采用语义化版本控制 [ 24 ]，并在一个注册表中建立索引。 其中一条规则最为关键：契约的变更必须与它所描述的接口变更在同一个批次（wave）中交付，也就是说，包含在同一个变更请求中，绝不能在其之后才交付。 当接缝的一侧是依据另一侧的源代码而非其书面契约来构建时，该技能也会触发——这正是智能体学习某个本应去阅读的接口的常见方式。

paragraphs.en: The review skill checks a change against the project’s own bar, derived from its bone layers, rather than against generic practice (R4), before merge and as the self-review before a change is declared ready. Its second job is detection. When a change invalidates a decision, a contract or a claim in a unit, the review routes that to curation instead of passing or failing the change on its own authority. The review skill never edits the knowledge base. One of its checks bears directly on Eq. ( 2 ): a change that assumes or contradicts a fact whose state record is past the project’s staleness horizon is held as needs-information until the record is re-verified. In release 0.1.0 that check reads the record’s age, not the decay check’s source-change flag; joining the two is design work, not a result.

paragraphs.en: Curation is a separate skill that audits the bone and proposes additions, updates, removals, merges and splits of knowledge units. It applies nothing without per-item human approval. This is where the authority axis is enforced: the agent does the reading, the comparison and the drafting; a human approves each change to what the project holds true.
paragraphs.zh: 策展是一项独立的技能，负责审核知识库的骨架，并提出对知识单元的新增、更新、移除、合并与拆分。 任何变更都必须经过逐项的人工批准才能生效。 这正是权威轴得以强制执行的地方：智能体负责阅读、比较和起草；而人类则对项目所认定内容的每一处变更进行批准。

paragraphs.en: Three design choices matter for the scaling argument. First, the check is silent on the healthy path, so its cost to a session is near zero when nothing has decayed. Second, it never prints a number for an unmeasured base: a fresh project reports the state uninitialised , not a reassuring zero. Third, it records every run, clean ones included, deduplicated by state (any number of sessions in one unchanged state add one record), so the series has a denominator: the record can answer what fraction of decay warnings led to curation, not only how many there were. Provenance and tier lints, and an attestation lint that checks that a change to governed knowledge carries an approval record, run alongside it with a self-test.
paragraphs.zh: 对于这个扩展性论证，有三个设计选择至关重要。 首先，该检查在健康路径上是静默的，因此当没有任何衰减发生时，它对会话的成本接近于零。 其次，它从不为未测量的基准输出数字：新项目会报告状态为未初始化，而不是给出一个令人安心的零。 第三，它记录每一次运行，包括无异常的运行，并按状态去重（处于同一未变化状态中的任意多个会话只增加一条记录），因此该序列具有分母：记录能够回答衰减警告中有多少比例导向了整理，而不仅仅是警告的数量。 来源与层级检查，以及一个验证受管知识的变更是否带有审批记录的证明检查，与它并行运行，并附带一个自测。

paragraphs.en: Change in OSTEON proceeds by ossification (R6) in three steps. A planner skill keeps one dated cycle per day in the bone and sets the bar that every task’s definition of done must clear. A starter skill then checks the plan against ten gate conditions before any work begins; where a condition fails on an open decision, it puts that decision to the owner as one question answerable in one line, rather than reporting that questions exist. Only a plan that passes the gate is executed. Execution may split the plan into independent lanes worked in parallel, by one session with subagents or by several, and finished work is carried back into the plan: a merge is not a completion until the plan says so. A delivery skill reports what a cycle delivered to people outside it, with each claim graded by what proves it.
paragraphs.zh: OSTEON 的变更通过三个步骤的骨化（R6）进行。 一个规划者技能在骨骼中每天保留一个带日期的循环，并设定每项任务的完成定义必须跨越的门槛。 然后一个启动技能在任何工作开始之前，依据十个关卡条件对计划进行检查；当某个条件因一个未决决策而未通过时，它会把该决策作为一个可以用一行文字回答的问题提请所有者裁决，而不是只报告存在一些问题。 只有通过关卡的计划才会被执行。 执行时可以把计划拆分为并行推进的独立车道，由一个带子智能体的会话或多个会话来承担，已完成的工作会被带回计划：在计划说完成之前，合并并不等于完成。 一个交付技能向循环之外的人报告该循环交付了什么，并且每项声明都按其证明依据分级。

sents.en: Change in OSTEON proceeds by ossification (R6) in three steps.
sents.zh: OSTEON 的变更通过三个步骤的骨化（R6）进行。

sents.en: A planner skill keeps one dated cycle per day in the bone and sets the bar that every task’s definition of done must clear.
sents.zh: 一个规划者技能在骨骼中每天保留一个带日期的循环，并设定每项任务的完成定义必须跨越的门槛。

sents.en: A starter skill then checks the plan against ten gate conditions before any work begins; where a condition fails on an open decision, it puts that decision to the owner as one question answerable in one line, rather than reporting that questions exist.
sents.zh: 然后一个启动技能在任何工作开始之前，依据十个关卡条件对计划进行检查；当某个条件因一个未决决策而未通过时，它会把该决策作为一个可以用一行文字回答的问题提请所有者裁决，而不是只报告存在一些问题。

sents.en: Only a plan that passes the gate is executed.
sents.zh: 只有通过关卡的计划才会被执行。

sents.en: Execution may split the plan into independent lanes worked in parallel, by one session with subagents or by several, and finished work is carried back into the plan: a merge is not a completion until the plan says so.
sents.zh: 执行时可以把计划拆分为并行推进的独立车道，由一个带子智能体的会话或多个会话来承担，已完成的工作会被带回计划：在计划说完成之前，合并并不等于完成。

sents.en: A delivery skill reports what a cycle delivered to people outside it, with each claim graded by what proves it.
sents.zh: 一个交付技能向循环之外的人报告该循环交付了什么，并且每项声明都按其证明依据分级。

paragraphs.en: The capture skill records what a session learned about the way of working: when something fails, when something is blocked before it lands, or when a check passes on an input that should have failed (R7). It appends to a ledger that governs nothing. At session end it tests whether an observation has independent corroboration; if it does, it nominates the observation and stops. A nomination becomes a rule only through the framework’s own register of named methodologies, under human approval. Sessions learn; they do not legislate.
paragraphs.zh: capture 技能记录会话在工作方式上学到的东西：什么时候某事失败了，什么时候某事在落地前被阻塞了，或者什么时候一个检查在本应失败的输入上通过了（R7）。 它只是向一个不治理任何东西的账本追加记录。 在会话结束时，它会检验某条观察是否有独立的佐证；如果有，它就提名该观察并停止。 一个提名只有通过框架自身对已命名方法论的登记、并经人工批准，才能成为规则。 会话只负责学习；它们不进行立法。

paragraphs.en: Two further skills keep the knowledge usable across gaps: an onboarding skill with a fixed read order (constitution, manifest, decision and state indexes, then only the relevant skills), which ends in an orientation whose first action names the fact it depends on; and a standup skill that keeps a per-track continuity journal so that a dormant project can be restarted, and routes blind spots to the role that owns them.
paragraphs.zh: 另有两项技能使知识在空档期间仍可使用：一项是入门（onboarding）技能，它有固定的阅读顺序（章程、清单、决策与状态索引，然后仅阅读相关技能），并以一次定向（orientation）收尾，其第一个动作会点明它所依赖的事实；另一项是站会（standup）技能，它为每条工作线维护一份连续性日志，使休眠的项目得以重启，并将盲点路由给负责该盲点的角色。

paragraphs.en: As a check rather than as evidence, we read OSTEON’s own version history. Its development spans 6 repositories and 58 commits by one author over 62 days, on 9 of which commits were made, and holds 54 governed artifacts (files of a governed-knowledge kind). The capture ledger received 28 observations, all on three consecutive active days, which produced 3 nominations and 1 curation record; no nomination can be traced by identifier into a rule, the repositories hold no decision records, and capture stopped 33 days before the last commit. The same reading surfaced a likely defect: 15 of the 28 ledger rows carry timestamps later than the commits that added them, which suggests local time recorded under a UTC marker. Capture, nomination and one curation record were exercised, over three days; decision records were never used; no nomination became a rule; and the six repositories include no bone of OSTEON’s own, so the tiers, the gates and the decay check were not applied to the discipline’s own development. The history shows the mechanisms in partial use by their designer and nothing more, and we report it for that reason. The collector and its output accompany the measurement data as ancillary files.
paragraphs.zh: 作为核查而非证据，我们查阅了 OSTEON 自身的版本历史。 其开发过程跨越 6 个代码仓库、由一位作者在 62 天内提交的 58 次提交（其中 9 天有提交记录），并包含 54 个受治理工件（受治理知识类型的文件）。 采集台账共收到 28 条观察记录，全部集中在三个连续的活跃日，由此产生了 3 条提名和 1 条策展记录；没有任何提名能通过标识符追溯到某条规则，各仓库中不存在决策记录，且采集在最后一次提交前 33 天便已停止。 同样的查阅还发现了一个疑似缺陷：28 行台账中有 15 行的时间戳晚于添加它们的提交，这表明在 UTC 标记之下记录的其实是本地时间。 采集、提名以及一条策展记录在三天内得到了行使；决策记录从未被使用；没有任何提名成为规则；此外，这六个仓库中不含任何 OSTEON 自身的骨件，因此层级、门控和衰减检查并未应用于该规范自身的开发。 这段历史只显示了其设计者部分使用这些机制的情况，仅此而已，我们正是出于这一原因将其报告出来。 采集器及其输出作为附属文件随测量数据一同提供。

paragraphs.en: Cost. The decay check, the lints and the review against recorded knowledge are mechanical, and the check is silent when nothing has decayed, so their cost per change does not grow with the rate of change. Human effort is spent on decisions, contract versions, curation items and plan questions, which we expect to grow far more slowly than the number of changes, because a project’s decisions are fewer and more stable than its edits. [Opinion] Curation items are the exception. A decay warning is raised by a change to a watched source, and watched sources change at a rate that tracks the change rate itself, so warnings may grow with r r even when decisions do not. Whether provenance at block granularity keeps warnings per change falling is the point on which the cost axis stands or falls, and it is Q2 of the agenda.
paragraphs.zh: 成本。 衰减检查、lint 检查以及对照已记录知识进行的评审都是机械性的，并且在没有任何内容发生衰减时检查会保持静默，因此它们每次变更的成本不会随着变更速率的增长而增长。 人力耗费在决策、契约版本、策展条目和计划问题上，我们预计这些的增长远慢于变更数量，因为一个项目的决策比其编辑更少且更稳定。 [观点] 策展条目是例外。 衰减警告由对被监视来源的变更触发，而被监视来源的变更速率本身会跟踪变更速率，因此即使决策不增长，警告也可能随 r r 增长。 块粒度的来源追溯能否让每次变更的警告数量持续下降，是成本这条轴成败的关键，这也是议程中的 Q2。

paragraphs.en: Coverage. The tiers and the contract rule extend governance to every seam that has a contract, and the contract skill is built to notice a seam that lacks one when one side is built against the other side’s source. The onboarding read order makes the governed set the first thing an agent reads, not an optional file it may skip.
paragraphs.zh: 覆盖范围。 分层结构与契约规则将治理扩展到每一个存在契约的接缝，而契约技能的设计目标是：当一侧基于另一侧的源码构建时，能够发现缺少契约的接缝。 入门阅读顺序使受治理的集合成为智能体最先阅读的内容，而不是它可能跳过的可选文件。

paragraphs.en: Currency. Block-level provenance turns exposure to source change from an unobservable property into a computed one; whether an exposed unit is in fact stale is settled in curation. In the terms of Eq. ( 2 ), the decay check is built to lower the effective s s by flagging decayed units before a session consults them. The review gate is built to check every change ( ρ = 1 \rho=1 ) for contradiction with the record, with its own probability g g in place of a reader’s d d ; it detects nothing the record does not hold current, so its value rests on the decay check having run.
paragraphs.zh: 货币性。块级溯源将对源变更的暴露从不可观测属性转变为可计算属性；某个已暴露单元是否确实过时，是在策展环节解决的。用式（2）的术语来说，衰减检查的设计目的在于，在会话咨询某个单元之前将其标记为已衰减，从而降低有效 s s。审查门的设计目的是检查每一项变更（ρ = 1 \rho=1）与记录是否存在矛盾，以其自身的概率 g g 代替读者的 d d；它检测不到记录未保持最新的内容，因此其价值取决于衰减检查是否已运行。

paragraphs.en: The following are constructed to show mechanisms. They are not observations.
paragraphs.zh: 以下内容是为展示机制而构建的，并非观察结果。

paragraphs.en: A seam drifts. An agent changes the unit of a field one service emits, from seconds to milliseconds, and updates its own tests, which pass. The consumer is untouched. Without a contract, the drift surfaces in production. In OSTEON the field’s unit is a clause of a versioned contract. The same-wave rule requires the contract change in the same change request, the version bump marks it as breaking, and the review gate flags the consumer side as built against the old version.
paragraphs.zh: 接缝发生漂移。 某个智能体把一个服务输出的字段单位从秒改成毫秒，并更新了自己的测试，测试通过。 消费方未受影响。 没有契约时，这种漂移会在生产环境中暴露出来。 在 OSTEON 中，字段的单位是版本化契约中的一个条款。 同波规则要求契约变更与代码变更放在同一个变更请求中，版本号的提升将其标记为破坏性变更，而评审门禁会把消费方标记为基于旧版本构建。

paragraphs.en: A decision is silently suspended. A project once rejected client-side caching of a price, for a reason recorded in a decision. Months later an agent, asked to cut latency, adds exactly that cache; the change is fast, tested and well argued. Review against generic practice would approve it. Review against the bone finds the accepted decision, reports the contradiction, and routes it. Either the change is withdrawn, or the decision is superseded by a new record that states why the old reason no longer holds. Either way, the project’s knowledge and its code agree afterwards.

paragraphs.en: A thesis about the limits of capability invites five objections. We state each in its strongest form.
paragraphs.zh: 一篇关于能力局限的论文会引来五种反驳。 我们将以它们最强的形式逐一陈述。

sents.en: A thesis about the limits of capability invites five objections.
sents.zh: 一篇关于能力局限的论文会引来五种反驳。

sents.en: We state each in its strongest form.
sents.zh: 我们将以它们最强的形式逐一陈述。

paragraphs.en: “A capable enough agent will keep the documentation current itself.” It can, but only if it can tell which documentation is stale, which requires knowing which source each claim came from and whether that source has changed since. That is provenance, and it is governance. An agent that rewrites documentation without it produces documentation that agrees with the code, not documentation that agrees with what the project decided. The objection is an argument for R5, not against it.
paragraphs.zh: “一个足够强的智能体会自己让文档保持最新。”它确实可以，但前提是它能判断哪些文档已过时，而这需要知道每条陈述来自哪个来源，以及该来源此后是否发生过变化。 这就是溯源，而溯源就是治理。 缺少溯源的智能体重写出来的文档，只会与代码一致，而不会与项目所作的决定一致。 这一反对意见恰恰是支持 R5 的论据，而不是反对它的理由。

paragraphs.en: “The tests are the specification.” Tests specify behaviour at the points they exercise. They do not record why a behaviour was chosen, which alternatives were rejected, who owns a field on the far side of a seam, or what is running in production. A change can pass every test and reverse a decision. The training route that uses test patches as specifications [ 2 ] is right to do so for learning to repair code; a project needs more than that to be governed.
paragraphs.zh: “测试即规范。”测试在其所验证的点上规定行为。 它们不会记录为什么选择某个行为、哪些备选方案被否决、接缝另一侧的某个字段由谁负责，或者生产环境中实际在运行什么。 一次变更可以通过所有测试，却推翻某项决策。 使用测试补丁作为规范 [ 2 ] 的训练路线，在学习修复代码这一点上这样做是对的；但要治理一个项目，仅此还不够。

paragraphs.en: “Governance will slow the agents down and teams will turn it off.” This is the strongest objection, and it is why cost is the first scaling axis. Governance that costs a human minutes per change will be skipped once changes arrive faster than humans can spend those minutes. The answer is governance whose per-change cost is mechanical and whose human cost attaches to decisions. Whether OSTEON achieves that is Q2 of the agenda; we do not claim it has been shown.
paragraphs.zh: “治理会拖慢智能体，团队最终会把它关掉。”这是最强有力的反对意见，也正是成本之所以成为第一个扩展维度的原因。 如果治理对每次变更都需要耗费人工数分钟，那么一旦变更到来的速度快于人类能投入这些分钟数的速度，治理就会被跳过。 答案是这样一种治理：其每次变更的成本是机械化的，而人工成本只附加在决策上。 OSTEON 是否实现了这一点属于议程中的第二个问题；我们并不声称已经证明了这一点。

paragraphs.en: “This is decision records and documentation as code, renamed.” The mechanisms have long roots, and we cite them in Section X . Three things are new. Decay is computed per Markdown block, for knowledge that lives outside the code (decisions, contracts, state records), from declared provenance to its sources against a sealed baseline, at every session start, rather than by comparing text with code after the fact or when a link breaks; inconsistency detection between code and its comments already does this for knowledge inside the code [ 25 ] , and we extend the idea to knowledge the code does not carry. The human authority boundary is stated as an invariant that does not move with capability. And the whole is defined as a discipline for a regime in which the reviewer can no longer verify by reading, which the older practices did not have to address.

paragraphs.en: SE 3.0 and agentic software engineering. Hassan et al. propose SE 3.0, an AI-native software engineering characterised by intent-centric, conversation-oriented development with AI teammates, and a technology stack and roadmap for it [ 7 ] . In later work, Hassan and colleagues describe agentic software engineering through a duality of SE for Humans and SE for Agents. Humans orchestrate and mentor agent teams in an Agent Command Environment, and agents work and call on human expertise in an Agent Execution Environment; structured artifacts such as merge-readiness packs and consultation request packs carry the exchange [ 8 ] . That vision is the nearest to ours, and several OSTEON mechanisms read as instances of it: the start gate’s one-question-at-a-time decisions resemble consultation requests, and review against recorded knowledge resembles an evidence-backed merge pack. We differ in two respects. We define the regime by verification capacity, so the discipline is about what happens when the human can no longer review by reading; and we make the scaling of governance, rather than the partnership, the defining property, and accompany the argument with a released artifact.
paragraphs.zh: SE 3.0 与智能体化软件工程。 Hassan 等人提出了 SE 3.0，这是一种以意图为中心、以对话为导向、与 AI 队友协作开发的 AI 原生软件工程，并给出了相应的技术栈和路线图 [ 7 ]。 在后续工作中，Hassan 及其同事通过「面向人类的软件工程」与「面向智能体的软件工程」这对二元性来描述智能体化软件工程。 人类在智能体指挥环境中编排并指导智能体团队，而智能体在智能体执行环境中工作并调用人类的专业知识；合并就绪包、咨询请求包等结构化工件承载着双方的交换 [ 8 ]。 这一愿景与我们的最为接近，且 OSTEON 的若干机制可视为其实例：起始门控一次只问一个问题的决策方式类似于咨询请求，而对照已记录知识进行的评审则类似于有证据支撑的合并包。 我们在两个方面与之不同。 我们以验证能力来界定该阶段，因此这一纪律关注的是当人类再也无法通过阅读进行评审时会发生什么；并且我们把治理的可扩展性、而非人机协作关系，作为定义性属性，同时以一个已发布的工件来支撑这一论证。

paragraphs.en: Programming with trust. Roychoudhury et al. frame the shift from programming at scale to programming with trust, and propose that trust in agent-written code be built from analysis evidence that travels with the change [ 9 ] . We share the premise that review by reading will not carry the load. paragraphs.en: The training route. Self-play SWE-RL trains an agent on real repositories with minimal data assumptions, specifies each bug by a test patch, and reports self-improvement on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-Bench Pro [ 2 ] . paragraphs.en: Context files. Gloaguen et al. evaluate repository-level context files in a controlled study. They find that the files do not generally improve task success while raising cost, that instructions are followed, and that overviews do not help [ 16 ] . In a smaller study of 124 pull requests in 10 repositories, Lulla et al. associate AGENTS.md files with lower agent runtime and output token use [ 26 ] . Earlier empirical studies catalogue the content, adoption and evolution of context files in GitHub repositories [ 20 , 21 , 22 ] ; our measurement differs in checking, against each repository’s tree, whether the paths a file names resolve. The two evaluations disagree on cost, one finding it higher and the other lower; we take no side, and our measurement bears on neither. OSTEON’s knowledge units are a different object from a context file: versioned, provenance-anchored, checked for decay and owned at one tier. Whether that difference changes the result is an open empirical question (Q4). Our measurement in Section IV is complementary to their evaluation: it describes how such files age in public repositories, not how they affect agents.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文文件。 Gloaguen 等人通过受控实验评估了仓库级上下文文件。 他们发现这些文件通常并不能提升任务成功率，同时还会增加成本；此外，指令会被遵循，而概述文件并无帮助 [ 16 ] 。 在一项针对 10 个仓库中 124 个拉取请求的较小规模研究中，Lulla 等人发现 AGENTS.md 文件与更低的智能体运行时间和输出 token 用量相关 [ 26 ] 。 更早的实证研究对 GitHub 仓库中上下文文件的内容、采用情况与演进过程进行了梳理 [ 20 , 21 , 22 ] ；我们的测量与之不同之处在于，我们会对照每个仓库的文件树，检查文件中列出的路径是否能够解析。 上述两项评估在成本问题上结论相反，一个发现成本更高，另一个发现更低；我们不站任何一边，我们的测量也与两者无关。 OSTEON 的知识单元与上下文文件是不同的对象：知识单元有版本控制、有来源锚定、会被检查是否过期，并且归属单一层级所有。 这种差异是否会改变上述结果，是一个有待实证的开放性问题（Q4）。 我们在第 IV 节中的测量是对他们评估的补充：它描述的是此类文件在公开仓库中如何老化，而非它们如何影响智能体。

paragraphs.en: Context governance. ContextNest formalises context governance for knowledge that agents consume, with typed documents, deterministic selectors, hash-chained version histories, checkpoints and audit traces, so that an organisation can reconstruct which knowledge versions informed an agent output [ 27 ] . It is the closest in mechanism. Its object is the eligibility and integrity of knowledge beneath retrieval; ours is the engineering lifecycle of project knowledge: decisions, contracts, decay against moving sources, and planned change. The two compose; a bone could sit on an integrity layer of that kind.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文治理。 ContextNest 为智能体所消费的知识形式化了上下文治理，采用类型化文档、确定性选择器、哈希链式版本历史、检查点与审计追踪，使组织能够重建是哪些知识版本影响了一个智能体输出 [ 27 ] 。 它在机制上最为接近。 它的对象是检索之下知识的资格与完整性；我们的对象是项目知识的工程生命周期：决策、契约、针对漂移源的衰减，以及有计划的变更。 两者可以组合；一个文档（bone）可以建立在这样一种完整性层之上。

paragraphs.en: Decisions, contracts and decay. The record of design decisions as first-class architectural knowledge [ 10 , 11 ] , the knowledge-management work that followed [ 29 ] , the lightweight decision record [ 12 ] , design by contract [ 24 ] , semantic versioning [ 23 ] , provenance modelling [ 17 ] , the laws of software evolution and ageing [ 4 , 5 ] , and the technical debt metaphor under which stale documentation is a debt that accrues interest [ 30 ] are the foundations OSTEON builds on. What is new is not any one mechanism but their combination into a discipline that agents operate and humans govern, with decay made computable at session start.
paragraphs.zh: 决策、契约与衰变。 将设计决策记录为一等架构知识 [ 10 , 11 ] 、其后的知识管理工作 [ 29 ] 、轻量级决策记录 [ 12 ] 、契约式设计 [ 24 ] 、语义化版本控制 [ 23 ] 、出处建模 [ 17 ] 、软件演化与老化定律 [ 4 , 5 ] ，以及把陈旧文档视为会累积利息的债务的技术债务隐喻 [ 30 ] ，这些都是 OSTEON 所构建的基础。 新颖之处不在于任何单一机制，而在于将它们组合成一门由智能体执行、由人类治理的学科，并使衰变在会话开始时即可计算。

paragraphs.en: Stale documentation and traceability. That documentation drifts from code is established: comments and code co-evolve only loosely [ 13 ] , and inconsistencies between them have been detected by rule [ 31 ] , by identifier analysis [ 32 ] , at scale [ 14 ] and at change time, before anything breaks [ 25 ] ; outdated content is among the most reported documentation problems [ 15 ] , and the maintenance of trace links between artifacts is a research field of its own [ 33 ] . The decay check differs in its object and its oracle: it watches knowledge that the code does not carry, and it compares declared provenance against a sealed baseline of its sources rather than text against code. The link check of Section IV is the routine kind.
paragraphs.zh: 文档陈旧与可追溯性问题。 文档与代码相偏离这一点已被证实：注释与代码只是松散地共同演化[13]，二者之间的不一致已通过规则[31]、标识符分析[32]、大规模检测[14]以及在变更发生时、问题出现之前被检测出来[25]；过时的内容是最常被报告的文档问题之一[15]，而维护工件之间的追溯链接本身就是一个独立的研究领域[33]。 衰变检查在对象和判定标准上有所不同：它关注的是代码本身不携带的知识，并且它将声明的来源与对其来源的密封基线进行比较，而不是将文本与代码进行比较。 第IV节中的链接检查是常规类型。

paragraphs.en: Q1: Does governed knowledge reduce stale-built change? Fix a set of decisions and contracts for a task set, written by the experimenters. Expose them to the agent as governed knowledge in one arm and as ordinary documentation, or not at all, in the other, at matched agent capability, and measure the fraction of merged changes that contradict them; the experimenters’ set is the oracle, so it is defined in both arms. Vary throughput at fixed review capacity within each arm. The thesis is weakened if the fraction does not differ between arms, if capability alone drives it to near zero, or if it does not rise with throughput once reviewers are saturated.
paragraphs.zh: Q1：受治理的知识能减少基于过期构建的变更吗？ 为一组任务确定一组决策与契约，由实验者编写。 在一个实验组中将其作为受治理的知识呈现给智能体，在另一个组中作为普通文档呈现或完全不呈现，同时保持智能体能力一致，然后测量与之相矛盾的已合并变更的比例；实验者的集合即为基准真值，因此在两个组中都有定义。 在每个组内，在评审容量固定的情况下改变吞吐量。 如果两组之间的比例没有差异，如果仅凭能力就使其趋近于零，或者一旦评审者饱和后该比例不随吞吐量上升，则该论点被削弱。

paragraphs.en: Q2: Does governance cost scale sub-linearly in throughput? paragraphs.en: Q5: Do gates hold against a more capable agent? paragraphs.en: Q6: When may agents curate? paragraphs.en: The paper reports no measurement of OSTEON’s effect, so nothing here shows that the discipline works; it shows what it does and why we expect it to matter. The measurement in Section IV is a single observational snapshot of popular public repositories. It counts unresolved path references in agent context files, a possible symptom of decay, not wrong instructions or their effect on agents, and its headline rate depends strongly on how references are read (Sections IV-D and IV-F ). The model in Section III assumes independent staleness, a fixed review capacity and a fixed detection probability. Real projects violate all three. The model also holds s s fixed as r r rises. The agent’s own changes are among the sources that make other units stale, so in practice s s rises with r r , and the model understates the effect in that respect. The model is meant to show the direction of the effect, not its size. The definition rests on a threshold relative to a project’s own engineers that mixes capability with throughput, is not crisp, and will be crossed at different times for different tasks; a reader who prefers to name the regime by its operative condition, verification capacity, loses nothing in the argument. OSTEON 0.1.0 targets one agent platform, and its mechanisms are designed by one author; independent use may expose costs we have not seen. Finally, governance has a cost, and a team may reasonably refuse it while agents still work in the delegated regime. Our claim concerns the superseded regime, where we argue the alternative is worse. What OSTEON’s own history shows, and does not show, is in Section VI-H .

paragraphs.en: Training is making software agents more capable, and it may make them more capable than the engineers who answer for the systems they change. We have argued that this capability is not enough, for three reasons. First, correctness is relative to decisions and contracts that the code does not carry. Second, this knowledge decays. Third, once agents outpace their reviewers, the changes built on stale knowledge escape review at a rate that grows with throughput. A snapshot of popular public repositories shows that the mismatch the second reason predicts is common, and does not show that it accumulates. Agent context files are common, and many of them stand still through hundreds of commits. Most of those that name repository paths name at least one that does not resolve. Files that stood still through more commits, however, do not have more unresolved references. Superintelligent software engineering is the discipline that answers this by scaling governance with capability. OSTEON is one concrete discipline for it, released with its scripts and data [ 3 ] . Whether it works is an empirical question, and we have stated the evidence that would settle it.

paragraphs.zh: 第四节中的测量结果已作为本预印本的辅助文件提供：带有日期偏差说明的预先指定方案（ README.md ）；用 Python 3 编写的数据收集、汇总、绘图、事后审计与修订脚本（ collect.py 、 summarize.py 、 figures.py 、 audit.py 、 extend.py ；除绘图脚本外均仅使用标准库）；数据集（ frame.csv ，搜索返回的每个代码库占一行；repos.csv ，每个上下文文件占一行，并带有符号链接标志；funnel.json ；summary.json ；candidates.csv ；audit.json ；以及 extended.json ，即修订时新增的统计数据）；以及图 3 背后的模型（ escape_model.py 、 fig-escape-model.json ）。
